_note: SYNTHETIC demo data. Stands in for OpenWeatherMap alerts + NewsAPI results for Manchester. Not real forecasts or news.

weather_alerts.headline: Cold snap forecast for Greater Manchester
weather_alerts.detail: Overnight lows near -4C expected from 16 Nov for around ten days.

weather_alerts.headline: Yellow wind warning - tram and rail disruption likely
weather_alerts.detail: Strong gusts could disrupt Metrolink and Northern services, pushing people towards taxis.

weather_alerts.headline: Icy mornings expected through January
weather_alerts.detail: Frost and ice usually slow Metrolink services on cold mornings, pushing some people to taxis.

economic_news.headline: Energy price cap set to rise 6% in January
economic_news.detail: The typical household dual-fuel bill is forecast to rise from 1 Jan 2027.

economic_news.headline: Manchester council tax rise proposed for April
economic_news.detail: A 4.99% increase is under consultation for the 2027/28 year.

economic_news.headline: Food inflation ticks up ahead of Christmas
economic_news.detail: Grocery prices up 3.8% year on year, with delivery fees rising at several platforms.

economic_news.headline: Manchester rents up 7% on last year
economic_news.detail: Average city-centre rents rose about 7% in the past year; renewals from spring are likely to follow.

economic_news.headline: Water bills set to rise from April
economic_news.detail: North West water bills are expected to rise by around 5% from April.

local_notes.headline: Manchester Christmas Markets open 13 November
local_notes.detail: Weekend market trips added about £60 to last December's eating-out spend for people in your area.

local_notes.headline: Retailers start Christmas offers mid-November
local_notes.detail: Buying gifts in the November offers rather than in December usually costs less.

local_notes.headline: Flu season: GP visits typically double December to February
local_notes.detail: Pharmacy spending on cold and flu remedies usually rises over winter.

local_notes.headline: Black Friday deals land 27 November
local_notes.detail: Many 'deals' match prices seen earlier in the year, so a 24-hour pause before buying avoids most regret.

local_notes.headline: January sales start on Boxing Day
local_notes.detail: Arndale and online sales run to mid-January; a short list made before Christmas keeps it to what you need.

local_notes.headline: Free warm spaces open across Manchester
local_notes.detail: Libraries and community centres offer free warm places to spend the day, which can cut heating costs.

local_notes.headline: Help with bills is available
local_notes.detail: The council and local charities offer one-off help with energy and food costs for households that are struggling.
